## Plan

1. `crates/hh-ontology/src/eval.rs` — `IntervalMethod::
   FiniteManifestContrast(prior)` dialect-bump member
   (`{finite_manifest_contrast: "beta{a,b}"}` — the Packet D interval
   method member; owning codec is hh-ontology, no generated schema).
2. `crates/hh-eval/src/finite_manifest.rs` (new — the eval-math owner):
   `finite_manifest_contrast(pop, decl)` over `PlannedPopulation` cells
   (same contrib counting rule — `contrib` goes pub(crate));
   independent per-cell `Beta(c+1, n−c+1)` posteriors; i64-ppm
   inverse-CDF draws by bisection on `regularized_beta` under
   canonical-input-seeded `XorShift64`; frozen ladder 8,000 base →
   64,000 cap (doubling record + `numerical_error` fact); analytic
   posterior mean; observed equal-task contrast; labelled 95%
   equal-tail `credible` interval; `Beta{2,2}` predeclared exploratory
   sensitivity; closed `ContrastError` refusal set (one task, missing/
   short/unresolved cells, dependence, pooled/unknown method, nonfinite,
   metadata-only, credible-as-TOST).
3. `crates/hh-eval/src/scorecard.rs` — the new member yields
   `n/a{estimator_undefined}` at cell level (a contrast method is never
   a per-cell interval).
4. `crates/hh-analysis/src/kernel.rs` — new kind
   `"finite_manifest_contrast"`: `AnalysisInput.view` (bound-experiment
   `ExperimentView` records-in) → `planned_population` → estimator →
   `finite_manifest_contrast` body member; method/prior from
   `spec.estimator_selection`; metadata-only cross-kind refusal.
5. `crates/hh-analysis/src/{error,report}.rs` — `Contrast` refusal
   variant + `record_kind` member.
6. `crates/hh-embed/src/analysis_ops.rs` — fold the bound experiment's
   `ExperimentView` for the kind; strict integer decode of the kind's
   numeric params (non-int → SchemaViolation, never a silent default).
7. Batteries: `crates/hh-eval/tests/r5_16.rs` (estimator contract —
   EX-02 known answers, refusals, determinism, doubling, constant-
   sample uncertainty), `crates/hh-analysis/tests/r5_16.rs` (kind
   routing → analyze_and_record persisted report; identity/body
   change; metadata-only/unknown-method/missing-view refusals),
   `crates/hh-embed/tests/r5_16.rs` (strict-decode + unbound-view
   refusals at the boundary).
